제3각법 3뷰와 반복: Three views in third-angle, and repetition
정면도 하나에서 뷰 두 개를 뽑아냅니다: Two views come out of the one front view
투상선다시 재지 않으려고 긋는다정면도 모서리와 원에서 위로, 오른쪽으로: ProjectorsYou draw them so you never measure twicePull them up and to the right from the edges and circles of the front view. They do not stay on the drawing; erase them when they have done their job.
평면도가로는 받아오고 세로만 정한다가로 120은 정면도에서 받아오고, 세: Top viewWidth comes across; only the depth is newThe 120 width comes from the front view. The 12 and 20 thicknesses are decided here for the first time.
우측면도높이는 받고 깊이는 옮긴다세로 90은 정면도에서 받아오고, 가로: Right side viewHeight comes across, depth is carried overThe 90 height comes from the front view; the width comes from the top view by way of the 45-degree line.
숨은선안 보이는 것도 그린다재료 속에 있어 안 보인다. 실선이면 보이는: Hidden linesYou draw what you cannot seeIt sits inside the material, out of sight. Drawn continuous it would read as a visible edge, so it is dashed.
세 뷰가 서로를 붙듭니다: The three views hold each other
배치가 틀리면 뜻이 바뀐다: Place them wrong and the meaning changes
본 방향에 그 뷰를 놓는다: The view goes on the side you looked from
위에서 봤으면 위, 오른쪽에서 봤으면 오른쪽. 제1각법은 반대로 놓아,: Looked from above, it goes above; from the right, to the right. First-angle puts them the other way round, so a different arrangement makes a reader take top for bottom.
뷰끼리 붙들어 맨다: They tie the views to each other
폭 120과 높이 90을 두 번 재지 않는다. 눈으로 맞추면 조금씩 어긋: You never measure the 120 width or the 90 height twice. Line them up by eye and they drift a little, and that drift shows up later when you dimension them.
있는데 안 보이면 점선: There but out of sight means dashed
보이면 외형선, 있는데 안 보이면 숨은선, 아예 없으면 안 그린다. 축: Visible, the visible line. There but hidden, the hidden line. Not there at all, you do not draw it. Looking down from above, the bore is behind material, so it is dashed.
깊이를 그대로 옮긴다: It carries the depth across as it is
깊이는 평면도에서 처음 정해진다. 45도라서 평면도의 세로 거리가 우측면: Depth is decided for the first time in the top view. At 45 degrees the vertical distance in the top view equals the horizontal distance in the right side view, so it cannot go wrong the way measuring with a rule can.
Remember Draw without knowing this and every line is right while the arrangement is wrong.
이 부품에서는 여섯 자리가 그렇게 정해집니다: On this part, six places are settled that way
새로 정하는 값은 두께뿐이다: The only new values are the thicknesses
The 120 width is given by the projectors; this thickness is the only value you set here.
보스가 앞으로 8 나와 12에 더한 값. 가로 자리는 보스 원 사분점에서: The boss stands 8 forward, added to the 12. Its horizontal position comes from the quadrant of the boss circle.
정면도에서 가로로 그은 투상선이 정한다. 맨 위 90은 보스 윗면이 만든: Set by the projectors drawn across from the front view. The 90 at the very top is made by the top face of the boss.
It is open front to back, so in both the top and the right side view it runs the whole 20 thickness.
It stops at 10 from the boss front face, so the dashed line ends in the middle of the thickness.
There is no boss there, so the dashed line only runs through the 12 plate thickness.

넷 다 선은 정확한데 자리나 종류가 틀립니다: In all four the lines are exact and the place or the type is wrong
아래에 그리면 제1각법이다: Draw it below and it is first-angle
선은 하나도 안 틀렸는데 도면 전체가 다른 뜻이 된다. 다 그린 뒤에 고: Not one line is wrong and the whole drawing means something else. Fixing it after everything is drawn means moving a whole view, so check it while you are placing them.
치수선에 긋는다: Draw them on the dimension layer
외형선에 그으면 흰 실선이라 형상과 구분이 안 되고, 지우는 것을 잊으면: On the visible line layer they come out white and continuous, indistinguishable from the shape, and if you forget to erase one you have an edge running off the sheet. Turn the layer off and they should all disappear.
레이어를 안 바꾸고 그으면 실선이 된다. 실선은 보이는 모서리라는 뜻이라: Draw without switching layers and it comes out continuous. Continuous means a visible edge, so a hole bored inside reads as a groove cut on the surface.
두께 전체로 그으면 도면이 깊이 10과 다른 말을 한다. 만드는 사람은: Run it the whole thickness and the drawing says something other than 10 deep. The maker drills what the drawing says, so a hole appears in the back face that has to sit flat against the frame.
고치는 법 그래서 그린 사람 눈에는 잘 안 보입니다. 다 그린 뒤가 아니: How to fix it That is why the person who drew it is the last to see it. Check at that step, not after everything is drawn.
정면도 하나에서 뷰 두 개: Two views out of one front view
정면도의 모서리와 원 사분점에서 구성선을 뽑아 폭 120과 높이 90을: Pulled construction lines from the edges and circle quadrants of the front view and carried the 120 width and 90 height straight across.
The only values you set today were the 12 plate thickness and the 20 where the boss is.
평면도와 우측면도를 투상선 교차점끼리 이어 그리고, 목 접점에서 끝나는: Drew the top and right side views by joining projector intersections, and kept the real step line that ends at the web tangent.
깊이는 45도 선을 거쳐 옮겼기 때문에 두 뷰의 두께가 어긋날 수 없습니: Depth came across through the 45-degree line, so the thickness in the two views cannot disagree.
숨은선은 축 구멍 20 전체·탭 10까지·장공 12 구간으로 다르게 넣고: Put the hidden lines in differently — the bore through all 20, the tapped holes to 10, the slots through the 12 section — and saved it as L05_VIEWS.
Select in one go and clear away the construction lines you drew to line the views up.
남은 형상선 토막은 TRIM으로 자르고, 못 미친 선은 EXTEND로 늘: Trim the leftover pieces of shape line with TRIM, stretch the ones that fell short with EXTEND, and erase lines with no boundary.
대칭 형상은 MIRROR로 다시 맞추고, 레이어가 틀린 선은 MATCHP: Set symmetric shapes right again with MIRROR, and move lines on the wrong layer home with MATCHPROP.
색·선 종류·선가중치를 ByLayer로 통일하고, 축척 0.5와 LTSC: Bring color, linetype and lineweight back to ByLayer, and set the dash spacing with the 0.5 object scale and LTSCALE.
표면 거칠기·기하 공차·재질·열처리 지시가 각각 무엇을 지시하는지 읽고: Read what surface finish, geometric tolerance, material and heat treatment notes each ask for.
